explanation: Jacob and Wilhelm Grimm began their Deutsches Wörterbuch in 1838 but died with it unfinished. Later scholars completed it in 1961, 33 years after the OED's first edition.

claims.text: The Grimms' Deutsches Wörterbuch was completed in 1961.
The first edition of the Oxford English Dictionary was completed in 1928.
Jacob and Wilhelm Grimm began the Deutsches Wörterbuch in 1838.
Both Grimm brothers died before the dictionary was finished.
